Mechanism-ratchet note (enumeration (7) of the epic's first comment — no `--update-stale` run is sanctioned for this story):

### (7) Baselines

`scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_ci.py:33-40`: `test_helper` = `tests/_*.py` (20 entries, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`); `ci_gate` = `scripts/check_*.py` files + workflow `run:` steps; `autouse_fixture` keys are `autouse_fixture::<path>::<name>` (142). E10 creates no `tests/_*.py`, no check script, no workflow step, so `new=0` for those kinds; Makefile lines are not censused. The only autouse fixtures in E10's touch set: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py::_clean` (identical bodies — the merge keeps the base key, the heldout key buckets `stale`), `tests/unit/test_audit_serve.py::_clean_ui_env` (base, unchanged), `tests/unit/test_prompt_repo_root_seam.py::_clear_caches` (kept in place). `--check` exits 0 with `stale>0` (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:51-57`); `--update-stale` is maintenance-only and must not be run. `.github/complexity-baseline.json` covers `PRODUCTION_SCOPE = "src/rebar"` only (`scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py:94`); the module-size gate is `find src/rebar` (`_build-and-test.yml:604-640`) — merged test modules above 800 LOC (e.g. `test_fixture_admission.py` 460+694) trip nothing.

For this story: `tests/unit/test_prompt_repo_root_seam.py::_clear_caches` is kept in place (the module is KEEP), so no autouse key changes; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` and `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` is not edited.

## Context / Problem
37 test modules (7,000 LOC, 486 collected nodes) pin one-time module splits as permanent invariants: re-export identity, "leaf" import shape, LOC floors and headroom, "shim no longer reachable". They fail on legitimate refactors and assert nothing about behaviour; 39 real behaviour tests are trapped inside them. 13 of the 37 were classified in the prior pass; the remaining 24 (4,795 LOC, 383 nodes) are classified per file in table (1), itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
Apply the prior pass's 13 classifications verbatim and table (1) (itemised in this ticket's first comment):
- `git rm` every DELETE-WHOLE file of table (1): `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_paging_split.py` (paging drain stays at `fetch/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py:156`, ceiling at `fetch/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py:116`), `tests/unit/test_decide_ops_seam.py`, `tests/unit/test_gate_dispatch_seam.py` (its memo test duplicates `tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_assemble_memo.py:152,175`), `tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py` (ids frozen at `tests/interfaces/store/test_ensures.py:56`), `tests/unit/test_prompt_model_module_seam.py`, `tests/unit/test_signing_module_split.py` (baked fallback stays at `tests/unit/test_attestation_signing.py:152`), `tests/unit/test_structured_run_seam.py` (lean import stays at `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_optionality.py:89`); plus the prior pass's DELETE-WHOLE files (the 8 `tests/scripts/*_seam_clean_heldout.py` modules and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_comments_split_import.py` among them) and `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py`.
- For each DELETE-BUT-MOVE file, move the named functions with their helpers to the named destination and delete the source: `tests/unit/test_agent_call_seam.py` is `git mv`-ed to `tests/unit/test_agent_call.py`, dropping `test_agent_call_clears_the_split_floor`, `test_agent_call_has_no_runtime_import_from_runner`, `test_runner_no_longer_builds_the_kwargs_dict_inline`, the `_loc`/`_SRC`/`_RUNNER`/`_AGENT_CALL`/`_SPLIT_FLOOR` constants and the `ast`/`pathlib` imports; `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_split.py` sends 3 tests into `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py` (reusing the existing `_codes` at `:135`); `tests/unit/test_config_resolver_seam.py` sends 3 tests + `_project` into `tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_source_threading.py` after `:177`; `tests/unit/test_gate_context_seam.py` sends 1 test into `tests/interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py` after `:61`; `tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py` sends `test_status_fold_replay_equivalence` + `_apply_status` into `tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py` (which imports `process_status` at `:10`; no name clash with `_status` at `:14`).
- KEEP the behaviour modules of table (1) unchanged; in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` delete `test_cloud_send_path_prose_names_shared_codec_owner` (`:35-42`) and rename the file to `test_rich_text_seam.py` (it is an unpaired held-out module).
- New files from the prior pass: `tests/unit/test_reconciler_repo_root_c0b9.py`, `tests/unit/test_logging_level.py`.
- Destination paths under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` are stated at the current name; the reconciler epic's rename carries them.
- `tests/unit/test_signing_module_split.py` is deleted here; the HMAC-retirement story fuchsia-wettish-leafbird must not also edit it.

Node arithmetic over all 37 files (486 nodes) + `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py` (3): 301 deleted, 39 moved, 149 kept (12 kept files unchanged = 128; `test_agent_call` 12; `test_rich_text_seam` 9).

## Scope
In scope: the 24 files in table (1), the 13 prior-pass files, `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py`, the two new files, and the destinations `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_source_threading.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py`, `tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py`, `tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_binding_absence_lifecycle.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_invariants.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_config_jira_wiring.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_cutover.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_hardening.py`, `tests/unit/test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py`, `tests/unit/test_mirror_guard.py`, `tests/unit/review_bot/test_rp04_s5_startup.py`, `tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py`, `tests/unit/grounding/test_resolve.py`. Out of scope: every file under `src/` and `scripts/`, the `Makefile`, `pyproject.toml`, and every test module not named in table (1) and the prior pass (the CI-parity, check-script and import-scan modules belong to S2, S3 and S4 of this epic).

## Testing
Before: `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split' | xargs pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider` → 486 nodes (+3 in `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py`). After: the 12 kept files + 2 renamed collect 149 nodes; each destination module collects exactly its prior count plus the moved nodes (39 in total); `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split'` lists only the 14 kept files; `make test` green; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`. Both collect runs are recorded on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 24 seam/split modules are gone from the tree, verified by `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split'` listing only the 14 kept files.
- [ ] Every moved test collects at its destination by node id (`pytest --collect-only -q <dest>::<name>` for each of the 39 moved nodes).
- [ ] 149 + 39 = 188 surviving nodes against 301 deleted, reconciled from the two `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`.
- [ ] `make verify` green.
